_meta.description: Paginated drive list from GET /api/vehicles/{vehicleId}/drives. Each item is a DriveSummary (subset of FR-3.4 for list rendering). Ordered startTime DESC, id DESC. THE TWO ITEMS DEMONSTRATE THE TWO NULLABILITY CONVENTIONS THIS SHAPE USES, AND THEY ARE NOT THE SAME CONVENTION. (1) OMIT-WHEN-EMPTY: the four location keys (startLocation/startAddress/endLocation/endAddress, MYR-145) are ABSENT on the second item, because the server may still have something to say about them later — a reverse-geocode can arrive after the drive ends. (2) REQUIRED-AND-NULLABLE: tripId (MYR-608, contracts v0.44.0) is PRESENT ON BOTH ITEMS — a cuid on the first, the JSON literal null on the second — because it is a DECIDED answer. It names the trip window the caller's own role places the drive in; null means no window of theirs covers it. An absent key would be indistinguishable from a server that does not send the field at all, and grouping drives under trips is exactly the feature that must not silently fall back to ungrouped. validateDrivesList asserts tripId as a KEY for that reason. fsdMiles/fsdPercentage are present on every item (MYR-152 promoted them to DriveSummary and marked them required; this fixture predated that and omitted them until MYR-608's review round). Deliberately omits energyUsedKwh/routePoints — those are in DriveDetail and DriveRoute. The SDK pairs this REST fetch with the WebSocket drive_ended subscription for FR-9.1/FR-9.2.
